business_outcome: Close the Run 008 retry/dead-letter/cancellation control gap so transient failures have bounded retry attempts, exhausted or deterministic failures have an accountable owner, cancellations suppress future retries, and dead-letter requeue requires explicit authority.
existing_owner_scan: Checked CAP-27 Retries dead-letter and cancellation, Run 008 recovery/replay/idempotency runtime, Run 004 transient/auth/cancellation evidence, SAFE controls and Pie Closure Wave 1. Run 008 already owns recovery/replay; no new team, queue service, database owner, control center or autonomous authority is required.
reuse_candidates_checked: Run 004 transient failure and authentication failure evidence
duplication_analysis: A separate retry manager or dead-letter team would duplicate Run 008. The bounded extension adds explicit retry budgets, dead-letter ownership and cancellation/requeue rules to the existing recovery boundary.
residual_unowned_loop: Current recovery logic classifies retryability and blocks unsafe replay but does not require owned dead-letter records, enforce a retry-attempt ceiling at the decision point, prove cancellation suppresses future retries, or require explicit authority to requeue dead-lettered work.
